messages:
emma_sales: Hey team — Pyxis asked for a clear, auditable process for handing over creds for the Private POC. They want BYOK + HSM-backed keys and short-lived certs for the first 2-week test. Can we outline a minimal, secure flow they can approve in their security questionnaire?

raj_se: +1. We should propose ephemeral certs (24h) and a one-time signing of a CSR by their HSM CA. Keep the secrets off email.

lisa_sec: High-level constraints from security: no long-lived plaintext keys shared; prefer KMS wrapped keys + attestable HSM signing; logs for every key usage; key rotation schedule.

omar_it: Thanks — our compliance team also needs to see the exact steps and an example command set. We use HashiCorp Vault for key material on our side. Is that compatible?

raj_se: Yes — compatible. Proposed approach: 1) We generate a CSR and a short-lived workload cert template. 2) Pyxis (you) sign the CSR in your HSM and return the cert. 3) We accept only certs with TTL <= 24h for the POC agents and require re-issuance automation. 4) Secrets (wrapped keys / certs) exchanged through your Vault Transit or an S3 presigned URL + strict ACLs.

emma_sales: Can you draft the exact commands and a one-page checklist we can paste into their questionnaire? Omar — would preferring Vault Transit for exchange work?

omar_it: Vault Transit is preferred. We can create a transit key and wrap the material. We'll also provide an HSM-signed root cert (PEM) and an OCSP responder if needed.

raj_se: Draft checklist + commands below (feel free to reuse):

--- checklist ---
- Create transient KMS/HSM key material in customer HSM (alias: pyxis/rdw-poc)
- Configure Vault Transit key (name: rdw-poc-wrap), set `allowed_operations = ["encrypt","decrypt"]`
- Generate CSR on Redwood side: `openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout rdw-poc.key -out rdw-poc.csr -subj "/CN=rdw-poc-agent/O=Redwood Inference"`
- Submit CSR to customer HSM admin for signing; request TTL <= 24h
- Customer returns `rdw-poc.crt` (PEM) and signs a signing-log entry (SHA256 of CSR) into their audit system
- Wrap the private key with Vault Transit: `curl --header "X-Vault-Token: <token>" --request POST --data '{"plaintext":"$(base64 rdw-poc.key)"}' https://vault.example.com/v1/transit/encrypt/rdw-poc-wrap`
- Share the resulting `ciphertext` string via a preconfigured Vault/Transit response (no email) or via a presigned S3 URL with `x-amz-server-side-encryption` enabled
- Redwood uploads the signed cert to the POC agent and uses the wrapped key via Transit decrypt at runtime (no raw key stored on disk)

--- end checklist ---

lisa_sec: Additions from security: include a rotation cadence (daily TTL for certs, weekly rotation for wrapping keys during the POC), and require customer-side KMS key policy to include `kms:GenerateDataKey` and `kms:Decrypt` only for a narrow role. Also enable CloudTrail-style audit for every Decrypt call.

raj_se: Good call. Also include a fallback path: if customer cannot do Transit, we can accept an ephemeral signed cert + ephemeral SSH/tunnel with mTLS to a private endpoint; but that requires an approved network ACL from their VPC team.

theo_sales_eng: Pricing note for customer-facing doc: POC with Private deployment (2 weeks, 1 dedicated pool tenant) — list of optional add-ons: extended observability, audit-log export, and a one-time setup fee for HSM integration. I'll attach the price tiers in the questionnaire response.

omar_it: One technical Q from our infra: can the Redwood agent request cert renewal automatically using a signed JWT from our Vault CA? We want automation without manual CSR exchange each day.

raj_se: Yes — we can do a small bootstrap: initial CSR signed manually, agent receives a bootstrap token with a short TTL (1 hour) that allows it to request renewals via the customer's internal CA endpoint using mTLS. We'll need the CA's API URL + client cert for that path. We'll document the minimal API surface: `/sign`, `/revoke`, `/ocsp` endpoints.

emma_sales: Perfect. Omar, I'll send this checklist + a short non-technical summary and the pricing note to your GRC reviewer. Can we get confirmation by EOD Friday?

omar_it: We'll try to confirm. Security wants the draft included in the questionnaire PDF.

lisa_sec: If they need an example policy snippet for AWS KMS, here's an inline example to paste: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rdw-poc-agent"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:SecureTransport":"true"}}}]}`

raj_se: Adding one more operational note: Redwood logs will include only key-id hashes and audit tokens, never raw key material. We'll provide an SLA appendix that outlines expected mean time to replace a rotated key during the POC (target: < 30 minutes).

deploy-bot: note: created ticket #POC-3421 for HSM integration work (assignee: raj_se, due: 2024-06-14) :white_check_mark:

emma_sales: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and post the questionnaire-ready text + an action checklist. Omar — ping me if you want a quick 20m screen share to walk through the flow. :calendar:
